facts.text: The Will To Do award ensures students will pay $0 out of pocket in tuition and general fees by covering any remaining amount after other aid is applied.

sources.title: SEMO Scholarships 2026-2027
sources.quote: The Will To Do ensures students will pay $0 out of pocket in tuition and general fees by covering any remaining amount after applying Pell, Access Missouri, institutional awards, and other tuition-specific grants/scholarships.
